papers.title: Selective laser melting of tungsten carbide reinforced maraging steel composite
papers.first_author_affiliation: Guangdong Institute of New Materials, 363 Changxing Road, Gunangzhou, 510651, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Nan Kang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Guangdong Institute of New Materials, 363 Changxing Road, Gunangzhou, 510651, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及的工具钢复合材料与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structures for stress shielding, no implant-related mechanical or fatigue testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光熔化制造碳化钨增强马氏体钢复合材料的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化工艺制备复合材料，并分析微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 获得了高密度复合材料，但未涉及生物医学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 仅有微观结构和基本力学表征。

summary_en.motivation: This work explores the feasibility of fabricating tungsten carbide reinforced maraging steel composites via selective laser melting for enhanced wear resistance.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was employed to produce the composite, and microstructural analysis was conducted.
summary_en.result: High-density composites were achieved, but no property relevant to biomedical implants was reported.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to basic microstructural and mechanical characterization without biomedical context.
